name: Queens Center
summary: Queens Center is a major enclosed regional mall in Queens, New York, featuring dozens of retail stores, department store anchors, and a food court. This coliseum-like shopping destination serves one of NYC's most diverse boroughs with a comprehensive mix of national retailers and dining options.
demographics: Queens Center attracts a diverse, multicultural customer base reflecting the demographics of Queens, one of New York City's most ethnically diverse boroughs. The primary trade area includes middle to upper-middle income families with household incomes ranging from $50,000 to $100,000+, with a strong representation of immigrant communities and multi-generational households. Shoppers span all age groups, with particular strength among millennials and Gen X families seeking value-oriented fashion and department store offerings. The center serves as a major retail destination for residents throughout Queens and neighboring boroughs who appreciate the convenience of having major department stores and national retailers in an accessible urban location.
description: Queens Center stands as one of New York City's premier indoor shopping destinations, serving the vibrant and diverse communities of Queens since its opening. This expansive coliseum-like enclosed mall houses an impressive collection of retail stores, anchored by major department stores and featuring a comprehensive mix of national retailers, specialty shops, and a bustling food court. Located at 90-15 Queens Boulevard, the center has established itself as a cornerstone of retail activity in the borough, drawing shoppers from throughout Queens and beyond with its convenient location and extensive tenant lineup. The mall's climate-controlled environment provides year-round shopping comfort, while its diverse merchant mix caters to the multicultural population that defines Queens. With operating hours from 10 AM to 9 PM daily and consistently high customer ratings (4.4 stars from nearly 32,000 reviews), Queens Center has proven its enduring appeal as a go-to destination for fashion, dining, entertainment, and everyday shopping needs in one of America's most dynamic urban markets.
